scope: Preserve standalone DXF ELLIPSE geometry and HATCH/MPOLYGON elliptical boundary fields when a finite nonzero axis or extrusion normal is extremely large or small and the public model has ratio greater than one. This does not qualify arbitrary HATCH boundary coordinate frames.
authority: Autodesk's ELLIPSE DXF definition specifies a WCS major-axis endpoint vector, extrusion normal and minor-to-major ratio: https://help.autodesk.com/cloudhelp/2020/ENU/AutoCAD-DXF/files/GUID-107CB04F-AD4D-4D2F-8EC9-AC90888063AB.htm. For a positive ratio above one, swapping the axes and shifting the parameter origin must preserve the evaluated points.
problem: The normalization used sqrt(x*x+y*y+z*z), which overflowed or underflowed for finite axes or normals that already passed the hypot-based geometry preflight. It then inverted the ratio even when no new major axis had been computed, silently changing the ellipse. The pre-fix generated control failed for major axis (1e200,0,0), normal (0,0,1), ratio 2.
change: Use hypot and normalized vectors to compute the new axis without squaring large values; publish the axis, reciprocal ratio and shifted parameters together only after the full result is finite. Writer preflight rejects unrepresentable expanded axes and nonfinite sweeps before publication, validates the direct normalized ellipse, and validates HATCH/MPOLYGON normalized boundary geometry and degree conversion. Public entity state and class layout are unchanged.
validation: The new libdxfrw_dxf_ellipse_extreme_axis test passes in ASCII and binary for 1e200 and 1e-200 axes/normals, independently evaluated start-point equivalence, exact normalized fields, unchanged caller objects, unrepresentable axis and sweep refusal, destination preservation and corrected same-writer retry. HATCH and MPOLYGON elliptical boundary controls cover finite normalization, unrepresentable axis, angle conversion, caller preservation and retry. Existing dxf_ellipse_extrusion_policy, dwg_ellipse_wcs_extrusion, and both dwg2dxf_r12_ellipse_carriers CLI selectors also pass; 5/5 focused CTests passed.
limits: An existing separate question about HATCH/MPOLYGON boundary Z components being omitted from their 2D DXF representation is not resolved by this numerical change. All test drawings are generated locally; no binary fixture is committed.
